note.label: Drowning in Sin & Perdition

precepts.why:
We go to Revelation because of “the mystery of iniquity.” Upon the woman’s forehead was a name written: “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” The mystery of iniquity that “doth already work” is this Mystery, Babylon the Great: the nation, the kingdom of perdition. That is the United States of America, and everyone that follows her policies.

Paul was always warning the disciples about this coming catastrophe, the man of sin. “And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.” What is being withheld is the return of Christ, because the man of sin must be totally revealed first. Israel is already in captivity now. “In his time” means this is his time now, as Luke 21:24 says, “until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.”

“only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.” God is the one letting them rule, until God decides, I am taking them out of the way. Babylon is the kingdom where that iniquity is working in the open today, and we have to wait for God to remove it.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

precepts.why:
The beast rising up out of the sea has “seven heads and ten horns”. John sees that same beast again: “I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.” The woman sits upon the beast, she being the eighth head.

“And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication.” Purple and scarlet, gold and precious stones: well off, wealthy, powerful.

“And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” Why is this important? Because judgment is like a ring. Babylon was the first, and it ends with Babylon again. It comes full circle, just as a ring: Babylon reigned over us, and now Babylon reigns over us again. There is nothing new under the sun; this is a whole loop.

That is why the beast of Revelation 13 is made up of the empires before it: like a leopard, the Greek philosophy and democracy of America; the feet of a bear, Persia; the mouth of a lion, the Babylonian doctrines found in America. This empire took all the ancient dark civilizations, learned from their mistakes, and merged them into itself. It is the same fourth beast of Daniel, the eagle of Esdras, the dragon of Revelation, and upon it sits Babylon the Great.

note.label: The Plagues Coming to America

precepts.why:
Deuteronomy 28:68 says the Lord would bring us into Egypt again with ships, and “there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.” Nobody can redeem us out of that Egypt, that house of bondage; only Christ, who bought us with a price, can redeem us from this spiritual Egypt.

Revelation 11:8 proves America is that Egypt: “And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt”. The dead bodies are the Israelites. Why dead? Because we don’t know who we are; we are in a dead state of mind; we left off keeping God’s laws.

Where is the great city? Revelation 17:5: “And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” That great city is Mystery Babylon the Great: America. And America is the abomination of the earth.

That is why it is spiritually called Sodom: sodomy goes on here; they legalized it. And it is spiritually called Egypt because, the same way the Israelites were enslaved in ancient Egypt, the Israelites were enslaved and are oppressed here in America: the land of oppression, the land of bondage, the land of slavery. What our forefathers experienced in ancient Egypt, they experienced here, and wherever those ships took us. And as God brought plagues on ancient Egypt, he is bringing plagues on this new Egypt.

note.label: Prophesy From Pain to Peace

precepts.why:
Revelation 17 ends with the woman: “the waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” Put up the Statue of Liberty: Lady Liberty sits upon many waters; she is everywhere. The ten horns, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark and Ireland, “shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” It will be an ambush; the entire country will be destroyed. “And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.” We call it a country; God calls it a great city. Nobody dominates America; America reigns over everybody.

Then chapter 18 opens right after: “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.” Why does it say fallen twice? Because Israel is the little Babylon.

“For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication”: her policies, the same thing Daniel 8 says, that through his policy he shall cause craft to prosper. All nations follow their policies. “And the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her”: the nations got in bed with her. “And the merchants of the earth”, the corporations and companies, “are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.”

“Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” That lets you know where the Israelites are: in Babylon. They say Babylon is Iraq. No, no, no: it is letting you know the twelve tribes are here.

Now the world is shifting to many powers, China and Russia rising, and this place is prophesied to fall. So prepare yourselves, mentally, physically and spiritually: this is war.

So leave social media alone. It was created to monitor you, brainwash you and control you. God is going to save the poor from their mouth, and their own tongue will bring them down.
